title: crataegus holmesiana var. tardipes
intro: Crataegus holmesiana var. tardipes, commonly known as a type of hawthorn plant, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Rosaceae family. The health benefits of Crataegus holmesiana var. tardipes include its potential to support cardiovascular health by lowering blood pressure and cholesterol levels, and its antioxidant properties may also contribute to its anti-inflammatory and anti-aging effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its flavonoids and oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), which may help to improve cardiovascular function, reduce inflammation, and enhance overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Crataegus holmesiana var. tardipes include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and OPCs, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties and contribute to its use in traditional medicine for various health conditions.
